$comment: Source for docs/REQUIREMENTS_TRACEABILITY.md (npm run orchestrate -- --trace). Status: implemented | partial | pending | blocked. Evidence paths must exist; the orchestrator checks them. 'tests' names test titles that must appear in tests/.

requirements.title: Immersive CYOA RPG with choices, clues, inventory and multiple endings
tests: locks choices until requirements are met
reaches multiple distinct endings and remembers them across restarts
shows an ending with endings found and play again
gaps: One sample story so far; immersion (art, sound) not yet designed

requirements.title: Dyslexia-informed reading presentation and optional reading support
tests: applies preferences as CSS variables and data attributes
glossary words reveal syllables
gaps: Not yet tested with dyslexic readers or on devices
Read-to-me uses device speech voices only

requirements.title: Program-flexible OG / structured-literacy terminology
tests: every profile labels only known concepts
falls back to the neutral description without a profile
gaps: The family's actual program and its terms are not yet known (master specification missing)

requirements.title: Recurring word sets woven naturally through stories
tests: counts word-set words, routes and target concepts
fails checks when a word set misses its minimum or a word is missing
gaps: 'Naturally' is judged by reviewers, not by code

requirements.title: Verifiable literacy reports and story-path validation
tests: passes the fixture and proves every ending reachable
finds soft-locks where every choice is locked
is reproducible: the same story gives the same report and hash
matches known vectors
gaps: Spelling-pattern detectors are heuristics; human literacy review still required

requirements.title: Parent-controlled story editing, versioning and publishing
tests: saves local versions without duplicates
only a human parent can approve, and AI agents cannot publish
requires a higher story version for each revision and after publication
gaps: Approval and publishing are CLI-only; no in-app publishing yet

requirements.title: Series-level learning progression
tests: records a missing prequel as a planning failure and recovers on re-plan
gaps: No sequel exists yet; no child progress model across books

requirements.title: Android phones and tablets (including Android 15) and Chromebooks
gaps: Not tested on any real device or emulator

requirements.title: Local-first persistence, no mandatory runtime AI service
tests: round-trips a saved game
reports failure when storage throws (quota or blocked storage)

requirements.title: Reusable AI story-generation requests and specialist review gates
tests: creates a planned job with all planning artifacts on disk
a request for changes blocks progress until a new revision

requirements.title: Accessible UI, low-bandwidth considerations, automated testing, controlled deployment
tests: renders a passage with heading, paragraphs, choices and packs
shows locked choices with a described hint and ignores presses
gaps: Accessibility audit is code review only; no automated axe/Lighthouse run

requirements.title: Eight operational specialist agents with contracts and verified invocation
tests: defines exactly the eight specialist agents
the narrative designer is barred from reviewing or approving its own work
gaps: Agents are started by a person or a Claude session; no unattended chaining

requirements.title: Orchestrated workflow passing structured artifacts between stages
tests: work items reference real artifacts and agents
orders work items by dependency
gaps: The orchestrator checks and sequences work; it does not spawn agents itself

requirements.title: Separate software and story production workflows
tests: moves through validation, review, parent approval and publication
gaps: Parent-facing story studio does not yet start production jobs

requirements.title: Review and publishing gates: no self-approval, human parent approval, no auto-publish
tests: does not let the narrative author review their own draft
never publishes just because validation passed
refuses to publish a draft whose file was edited after review
rejects a story that claims a passed literacy review nobody recorded
gaps: Human identity is attested by whoever runs the CLI, not verified

requirements.title: Automated tests for the full story workflow and an end-to-end demonstration
tests: validates required fields and literacy concepts
allows only listed transitions
records unparseable agent output as a stage failure and accepts a retry
invalidates reviews and parent approval when a new revision arrives
gaps: Human steps in the demonstration are simulated
